name: universal
description: Errors shared across operating systems and toolchains.

rules.title: A port is already in use
rules.summary: Another process is listening on the address or port this command tried to bind.

any: Only one usage of each socket address

causes: A previous development server is still running.
Two services are configured for the same port.
actions: Find the process listening on the reported port and confirm what it is.
Stop that process if it is stale, or configure one service to use a different port.

rules.title: The process lacks permission
rules.summary: The operating system refused a file, directory, socket, or process operation.
causes: The target belongs to another user or is read-only.
Another process or security tool has locked the target.
The command is writing outside the intended project directory.
actions: Inspect the exact path and its owner before changing permissions.
Close processes that may hold the file, then retry.
Prefer a user-owned project or cache directory instead of running the command as administrator.

rules.title: The destination is out of space
rules.summary: The filesystem cannot accept more data or inodes.

any: not enough space on the disk

causes: A temporary or container volume reached its limit.
A Unix filesystem ran out of inodes.
actions: Check free space on the exact filesystem named in the error.
Remove unneeded build artifacts or expand the correct volume.
Retry only after confirming the destination has room.

rules.title: A required command is missing
rules.summary: The shell or parent process could not find an executable on PATH.

any: is not recognized as an internal or external command

causes: It is installed but its binary directory is not on PATH.
A project-local tool should have been invoked through its package runner.
actions: Identify the missing command from the first error line.
Install it from its official source or use the project-local runner.
Open a new terminal after changing PATH.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification failed
rules.summary: The client could not build a trusted certificate chain for the remote service.

any: unable to get local issuer certificate

causes: The machine trust store is missing a required certificate.
A corporate proxy is intercepting TLS.
The remote certificate is expired or misconfigured.
actions: Check the system clock and the remote certificate first.
Ask your network administrator for the correct CA certificate when a managed proxy is involved.
Do not disable certificate verification as a workaround.

rules.title: The process ran out of memory
rules.summary: The runtime or operating system could not allocate enough memory to continue.
causes: The workload exceeds the current memory limit.
A container or CI job has a lower limit than the local machine.
A leak or unbounded input caused memory growth.
actions: Measure peak memory and inspect the first operation that grows without bound.
Reduce concurrency or input size to confirm the cause.
Increase a limit only after ruling out a leak.
